_comment: References only — NEVER put actual secret values here. Maps env var names to Bitwarden items on https://vault.zhengzhicheng.com. 'field' defaults to 'password'; 'username'/'notes'/'uri' read the login fields; any other value is the name of a custom field on the item. Loaded lazily by `load_secrets` (basic/shell/common/functions/load_secrets).
